items.title: 15.3.2 Be-rang maddon ke liye locating agents (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.3.2, printed pages 330-331.

blocks.title: Chromatogram aur locating agent
blocks.text: Kaghaz sookhne par us par bana pattern chromatogram hai. Rangeen ajza aankh se pehchane ja sakte hain; be-rang hon to chromatogram ko kimiyai ya physical techniques se develop karna parta hai. Locating agent woh chemical hai jo amino acids jaise be-rang maddon se react kar ke rangeen products deta hai jo dekhe ja sakte hain.
Be-rang chromatogram dekhne ka aasan tareeqa use UV lamp ki roshni mein dekhna hai, jahan spots rangeen nazar aate hain. Ya ninhydrin jaisa locating agent spots dhundne ko istemal hota hai.

blocks.caption: Be-rang spots nazar aane lana
rows: spots ultraviolet roshni mein chamakte ya jazb kar ke rangeen nazar aate hain
maddon (amino acids) se react kar ke rangeen products banata hai

blocks.prompt: Chromatogram develop karne ka kya matlab hai, aur locating agent kis liye istemal hota hai (exercise Q.2h; MCQ IX)?
blocks.explanation: Develop karne ka matlab sookhe kaghaz ko yun treat karna ke na-nazar, be-rang spots dekhe ja sakein, ya to ultraviolet roshni mein dekh kar ya locating agent chhirak kar. Ninhydrin jaisa locating agent be-rang ajza, maslan amino acids, se react kar ke rangeen products deta hai jo un ki jagahein nishan-zada karte hain.

items: Chromatogram = sookha pattern; be-rang spots UV lamp ke neeche ya ninhydrin jaise locating agent se dikhaye jate hain (amino acids ke saath rangeen products).
